- tablet_yuki: Assumed it stayed at desk_b1 during work hours. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 in the morning. Check kitchen_table_k1 first for Yuki’s tech during the day.
- mug_yuki: Assumed it remained at desk_b1 or moved to coffee_table_l1. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 (morning/afternoon) and coffee_table_l1 (late evening). Check kitchen_table_k1 during the day; check coffee_table_l1 after 22:00.
- glass_yuki: Assumed it stayed at nightstand_b1 or moved to coffee_table_l1. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 (afternoon) and nightstand_b1 (late evening). Check kitchen_table_k1 during the day; check nightstand_b1 after 22:00.
- water_bottle_yuki: Assumed it was at coffee_table_l1. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 in the evening. Check kitchen_table_k1 for Yuki’s hydration items.
- glass_nora: Assumed it stayed at nightstand_b2 or moved to kitchen_table_k1. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 (early evening) and cupboard_k1 (late evening). Check kitchen_table_k1 first; if not there, check cupboard_k1.
- water_bottle_nora: Assumed it was at coffee_table_l1 or kitchen_table_k1. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 (early evening) and dish_rack_k1 (late evening). Check kitchen_table_k1 first; if not there, check dish_rack_k1.
- book_nora: Assumed it stayed at nightstand_b2. Actually found at armchair_l1 in the evening. Check armchair_l1 for Nora’s reading materials in the evening.
